visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of a man and a Corgi dog. The man, seen from the side on the right, is looking down affectionately at the Corgi on the left. The Corgi is panting with its tongue out, looking up at the man. In the background, there is a pink padded chair and a table, suggesting an indoor home environment with warm, soft lighting. (2) The camera pans and cuts as the Corgi walks away from the man toward an older woman crouching in the center of the room. The woman is wearing a black shirt and dark pants. The room features white tile flooring and various household items on shelves in the background. (3) The woman gently holds the Corgi while preparing a small medical syringe. She carefully pulls up the skin on the dog's back and administers an injection. The dog remains remarkably still and calm during the process. The lighting remains bright and consistent. (4) After the injection, the woman pets the dog's head, and the man's hand reaches in to pet the dog as well. The dog turns its head and looks toward the camera/the woman with a relaxed expression. The scene concludes with a sense of relief and care.
